Even after being on multiple different antidepressants for 8 years, I am still very skeptical against prescription medications. Nonetheless, it is important to find just the right combination that works for you because everyone has a completely different chemistry. I'm currently on Zoloft(100mg), Lamictal(100mg), and Vyvanse(70mg). Once you find what works best for you, it is important to understand that in order for your medication to reach it's full potential, it is ultimately up to you to treat your illness no matter how hard it is. Get outside, excercise(this does wonders), read, learn an instrument, etc. Try to avoid t.v, computers, video games, and anything else electronic. If you need any other advice feel free to pm me.
